svg.text: LAUNCH FILM · STORYBOARD V2 · SAAS LAUNCH CUT
Extreme close-up of brew's timecode in IBM Plex Mono, digits rolling. A green playhead
slides through frame. Shallow depth of field: outer digits fall off into blur.
Camera: 100mm macro, slow push 3%. Digits roll on the beat. Playhead crosses L→R in
1.2s; anamorphic green flare on its edge.
Single low sub hit on frame 1, then a ticking clock pattern in the hats.
Hard cut on the downbeat to type.

g.text: V2 · SHOT 02 — YOU HAVE THE IDEAS.

svg.text: Full-bleed statement, white with a soft top-to-bottom gradient. Nothing else on
Words cut on in time with kick drums (one word per beat), each with a 4px vertical

g.text: V2 · SHOT 03 — NOT THE EDIT BAY.

svg.text: "Not the edit bay." in grey, with ghosted timeline tracks and a hundred tiny file
chips stacked behind it at 6% opacity. The mess is texture, not content.
Background tracks drift left at different speeds (parallax). Statement holds still:
the only calm thing on screen.
A muffled pile of notification pings under the music, ducked.
Lights drop to black; a green glow rises from below.

g.text: A finished script, or one line about the idea. Both work.
Why the Panama Canal ran short of water
First video free · up to ten minutes

svg.text: brew Studio rises out of darkness, tilted in perspective, lit from below by a green
glow, with diagonal light beams raking across its glass edge. Floor reflection under
Camera: low angle crane up, 20° → 8° tilt over 2.5s (ease in-out). Glass edge catches
the beams as they pass. Logo resolves top-centre.
Music opens up: pad + bass enter. Soft "air" swell into the logo tick.
